description: Información del tráfico en zonas Wi-Fi en el Valle del Cauca is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. Describe el nivel de consumo de datos en las distintas zonas Wi-Fi en el Valle del Cauca. Coverage: Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are trafico zonas wi-fi, zona wifi, consumo de datos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2022-01-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
